description: Evaluation cases for the sns-proposal-digest skill. Tests whether an agent, asked to summarize IC governance, reads the keyless NNS + SNS APIs, filters to open/votable proposals, keys on proposal_id (not the row id), and produces a deduped per-proposal digest without attempting to vote or submit.

output_evals.name: Open NNS proposals, keyless
output_evals.prompt: What NNS proposals are open for a vote right now? Give me a short digest.
expected_behaviors: Reads the public NNS proposals API (ic-api.internetcomputer.org/api/v3/proposals), keyless
Narrows to live votes with include_status=OPEN (or an equivalent status filter)
Summarizes each as proposal_id, topic, one-line intent, status, and voting deadline
Does not attempt to vote or submit anything - it is a read-only digest

output_evals.name: Sweep SNS DAO proposals
output_evals.prompt: Include SNS DAO governance too, not just NNS.
expected_behaviors: Enumerates launched SNS DAOs from the SNS API (sns-api.internetcomputer.org/api/v1/snses)
Pulls each watched DAO's open proposals via its governance canister / the SNS aggregator
Groups the digest by source (NNS and each SNS)

output_evals.name: Key on proposal_id, not the row id
output_evals.prompt: Which field identifies the proposal - the id field in the response?
expected_behaviors: States proposal_id is the governance proposal number to report and dedup on
Explains the row id is an internal record id, not the proposal number
Uses proposal_id for the seen-set so each proposal is reported once

output_evals.name: Signal-only digest
output_evals.prompt: I don't want to be spammed - only tell me about genuinely new things.
expected_behaviors: Keeps a seen-set and emits only proposals that are new or newly open since the last run
Sends nothing when there is nothing new or open
Flags a proposal closing soon (short deadline) for priority

trigger_evals.description: Queries that should load this skill vs. ones that should not.
should_trigger: What SNS DAO proposals are up for a vote?
Give me a governance digest for the IC
What's up for a vote on the NNS this week?
Track SNS proposals for a DAO I follow
should_not_trigger: How do I vote on an NNS proposal?
How do I create and submit an SNS proposal?
Launch an SNS for my dapp
How does NNS neuron staking work?
